name: oca-workspace-projection
title: OCA Workspace Projection — Read-Only ADV State Surfacing
purpose: Capability: OCA reads ADV worktree registry state from snapshot.json to project workspace status into OCA session listing, tmux status bar, and CLI output. Non-authoritative, rebuildable, graceful degradation.

requirements.title: Workspace Projection Reads snapshot.json
requirements.body: ProjectWorkspaceStates must read $XDG_DATA_HOME/opencode/plugins/advance/{projectID}/snapshot.json and parse worktree_registry entries into WorktreeWorkspaceState structs. Returns empty (never nil) when unavailable.

scenarios.title: Graceful degradation when snapshot missing
given: No snapshot.json exists for the project

scenarios.title: Parse worktree_registry entries
given: snapshot.json exists with worktree_registry containing setup_failed entry

requirements.title: Session Enrichment with Workspace State
requirements.body: EnrichSessionsWithWorkspaceState must match OCA sessions to ADV worktrees by path, change-derived name, or branch-derived window name. Enriched sessions carry workspaceStatus, workspaceChangeId, workspaceBranch, workspaceSetupReady, workspaceFailure fields.

scenarios.title: Path match enriches session
then: Session is enriched with workspace status from that worktree

scenarios.title: No match leaves fields empty
given: Session does not match any worktree
then: Workspace fields remain empty on that session

requirements.title: Branch Safety and Workspace State in Status Bar
requirements.body: The tmux status bar must show: (1) ⚡ when on a default branch while ADV has active changes, (2) compact workspace state glyphs (✗ setup_failed, ѻ stale, ✓ merged, ␡ pending_delete), (3) workspace status suffix on change window glyphs.

scenarios.title: Unsafe trunk shows warning
then: ⚡ glyph appears next to the branch name

scenarios.title: No glyphs without ADV state
then: No branch safety or workspace state glyphs appear
